canonical_project: Phu Yen provincial integrated data center
owner: Phu Yen Department of Information and Communications / provincial government
notes: Phu Yen's integrated data center (Trung tam Tich hop du lieu tinh Phu Yen) has operated under the provincial Department of Information and Communications since the early 2010s; a 2014 Tuoi Tre article on an internal disciplinary case confirms its existence and a thesis documents its development strategy to 2020. Public-sector scale, no MW disclosed.
